digest.component_or_area: Store write lock acquisition and retry
propositions: A store write whose lock acquisition times out is permanently discarded with no retry or recovery; the budget is terminal and lossy rather than a queue.
Holder duration exceeding the 60s acquisition budget causes all waiters to fail regardless of service order, making fair queueing ineffective.
Bounded retry-with-backoff inside acquire() converts write loss into latency without replaying the write body, since LockTimeout is raised before acquire() returns.
Five call sites opt in to retry via retries=_write_path_retries() reading REBAR_LOCK_RETRIES (default 2, clamped [0,10]), while all other callers keep fail-fast through retries=0 default.
Retry passes release between attempts with jittered exponential backoff (0.5s, 1.0s, cap 2.0s), giving a cumulative ceiling of ~181.5s across 3 passes plus backoff.
Each exhausted pass logs a warning naming the holder, and terminal LockTimeout names cumulative wait plus holder; txn._acquire_write_lock now propagates the full message instead of a generic string.
